axisReviews.evidence: Universal suffrage and government by the consent of the governed underpin his public argument.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Prioritising Black male voting during Reconstruction did not cancel his longstanding advocacy of women’s voting rights.

axisReviews.evidence: Free speech, resistance to slavery and protection from arbitrary coercion favour liberty.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He accepted armed self-defence and federal enforcement of emancipation; temperance advocacy does not establish blanket approval of drugs.

axisReviews.evidence: The composite-nation speech explicitly includes multiple races and immigrant communities.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Shared citizenship and integration remain fundamental; diversity is not a demand for separate identities to override national rights.

axisReviews.evidence: His composite-nation argument defends Chinese immigration and rejects racial limits on migration.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Modern welfare eligibility, sponsorship and university visas have no exact historical equivalent; these are extensions of his inclusive principle.

axisReviews.evidence: He backed the Union’s armed struggle against slavery and Black military service while opposing domination and annexation.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Emancipatory war is not universal pacifism or a preference for perpetual foreign conquest; modern autonomous weapons are inferred cautiously.

axisReviews.evidence: Universal human rights coexist with a strong commitment to a reformed American republic.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His diplomacy and anti-annexation stance qualify a nationalist label, but he did not supply a blueprint for modern supranational economic institutions.

axisReviews.evidence: Free labour, property rights and personal initiative coexist with public education and national protection of rights.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Abolition of ownership of people is not a proposal for abolition of ordinary private business; modern public-service ownership is an analogy.

axisReviews.evidence: Opportunity and free labour in an internationally connected republic favour exchange with some public safeguards.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No comprehensive tariff doctrine was found; Republican affiliation is insufficient to assign protectionism automatically.

axisReviews.evidence: Self-directed labour and initiative favour market decisions over compulsory production direction.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Public education and protection against exploitation remain; modern minimum-wage and private-currency items are tentative institutional translations.

axisReviews.evidence: Fair opportunity and assistance for emancipation coexist with strong emphasis on self-directed labour and earned independence.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He recognised dependence on others and structural injustice; self-help is not evidence against every public transfer.

axisReviews.evidence: He condemned churches legitimising slavery and defended equal citizenship over sectarian domination.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Christian moral argument remained central, but invoking faith does not create religious courts or a clergy veto on civil legislation.

axisReviews.evidence: Women’s rights and his interracial marriage challenged inherited discriminatory social conventions.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No modern abortion or gender-identity programme was found; equal rights coexist with period-specific family assumptions rather than universal modern progressivism.

axisReviews.evidence: Education, communication and material progress are opportunities for emancipation when used with human safeguards.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Modern AI, neural implants and embryo enhancement have no historical counterpart; irreversible interventions are cautiously inferred rather than asserted as documented beliefs.

axisReviews.evidence: National protection of citizenship and Reconstruction rights override local permission for slavery or disenfranchisement.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Local agency and free institutions remain; federal enforcement of equal rights is not evidence for national command of every service.

axisReviews.evidence: Literacy, slavery’s social damage and opportunity are powerful causes of human development in his argument.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He acknowledged native capacities and personal effort; equality of rights is not itself a precise claim about all inherited psychological variation.
